terminals.name: website-dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1; exec pnpm dev
terminals.description: Runs `pnpm dev`: the Hono API on port 8788 and the Vite web dashboard on port 8787 (which proxies /api and /hooks to the API).
